recentItems.title: Rain Story (Official Video) | Debattama | Suhit Abhyankar | New Hindi Song 2026 | Romantic Song
recentItems.description:
Times Music presents ‘Rain Story’, a beautiful Hindi romantic song sung by Debattama, with music by Suhit Abhyankar. This heartwarming love story takes you back to the innocence of school-time love, first crushes, and the unforgettable moment when two people meet for the first time, with the rain turning an ordinary day into a memory they carry for years. From shy glances and a first conversation to little fights, and a love that grows with time, Rain Story captures the feeling of falling in love with your childhood sweetheart.

If you love new Hindi songs, Hindi love songs, new songs, Debattama songs, first love songs, school love stories, add 'Rain Story' to your playlist and relive the magic of your first love. Watch the full music video featuring Debattama and Suhit Abhiyankar, and share the moment that reminded you of your own love story. ❤️🌧️

recentItems.title: Long Way from Home (Lyrical Video) | MC SQUARE | Radhika Bhide | Wicked Sunny | The Local Kid EP
recentItems.description:
Times Music presents the lyrical video of 'Long Way From Home' by MC SQUARE, Radhika Bhide and Wicked Sunny, the lead single from Wicked Sunny's debut EP, 'The Local Kid'. Already a viral sensation on Instagram, this lyrical version puts every word on screen. At its heart is a deeply personal story about leaving home, chasing dreams in a new city, and carrying the place you came from, while building your future.

Blending Indian hip-hop, rap, and folk-inspired storytelling, each artist brings their own voice to the same ache, so the track plays as one shared story. 

Press play and let the lyrics hit as you follow along.
